guarantees.claim: err_entropy_ready is driven 1'b0 by default, and is set to 1'b1 when (st == StIdle) & (st_d == StMsgFeed) & kmac_en_i & !cfg_entropy_ready; otherwise 0.

assumptions.claim: cfg_entropy_ready is a stable configuration signal that accurately reflects entropy source readiness before message processing begins, and does not change during the sensitive window when (st == StIdle) & (st_d == StMsgFeed) & kmac_en_i is true.
assumptions.risk: If cfg_entropy_ready toggles or is deasserted after this check, err_entropy_ready may miss a real loss of entropy readiness, leading to message feed without adequate entropy and compromising cryptographic strength.

uncertain_points.claim: Entropy readiness is only checked at the exact point of transition from StIdle to StMsgFeed when kmac_en_i is active. If entropy readiness is lost after that transition (during message feed), err_entropy_ready stays deasserted, potentially allowing ongoing processing with insufficient entropy.
uncertain_points.cond: cfg_entropy_ready deasserts after st has left StIdle
uncertain_points.risk: KMAC may process data with weak or absent entropy, compromising MAC/key derivation security.
